review_input.original_instruction: Our starting point is in seating area, and we're facing towards beside the window there's a chair and a bench, turn around and exit through the door that's between the two curtains... We're now facing a living room, walk towards the chair that's in the centre of the room, walk towards the chair that's on your left, and then, walk towards the threshold of the door that's towards the right, turn slightly to the left and enter the room that's n front of you... We're now facing towards a table with books on top, turn right... You'll come across, actually, two doorways, walk towards the doorway that's on your right and walk pass the hallway, turn towards the left, leaving the small round table towards the right, and you'll come across a staircase, do not go down, walk pass the staircase towards the right, on your right there's a hallway, do not walk into the hallway, then towards the left, and in front of you there' will be a long window, walk towards the right side of the window, and that is your destination.

subtasks: Our starting point is in a seating area. We are facing a window, with a chair and a bench beside it. Turn around and exit through the door between the two curtains.

Now you are facing a living room. Walk towards the chair in the centre of the room, then towards the chair on your left. Walk towards the threshold of the door on the right, turn slightly to the left, and enter the room in front of you.

Now you are facing a table with books on top. Turn right. You will come across two doorways; walk towards the doorway on your right and walk past the hallway. Turn left, leaving the small round table on your right. You will come across a staircase; do not go down. Walk past the staircase towards the right. There is a hallway on your right; do not walk into the hallway. Then move towards the left. In front of you there will be a long window. Walk towards the right side of the window. That is your destination.
